title: When the Will Falls
author: Felix Reyes
blurb: Paloma Blackwood, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
